subject: [hw] DONE opus-perf: core 1.6x faster on Thumb (decode cache + fast paths), vendor encode = ~12k guest insns/frame; nested-stop fix; V14 BLX lr bug fixed
body:
Host only; no phone, nothing published. Details + numbers: gpu/hwcodec/tests/perf/STATUS.md.
LOAD: run_vmix.sh on opus-venc /tmp tree (M-f, fake VENC, SEQ_HDR + 6 frames): per frame 11-13k guest instructions of codec work, the same at 320x240 and 1920x1080 (RC runs on the VENC RCPU); ENC_INIT 0.94 M once (98% CirQueue_Create); ~65 host calls/frame. Not interpreter-bound: <1 ms/frame even at 15 MIPS. Top CPU risk is vpud GET_LOG_OBJECT busy poll (posted to V40/IV) and n2vhost always attaching the T01 trace (posted to IV).
SPEED (i5-10210U @1.9 GHz, cycles/guest insn, min of 3): Thumb mix 70.7 -> 44.3 (1.6x), Thumb integer 49-53 -> 29-37, A32 96.8 -> 86.6 (cache only); ~50-80 MIPS Thumb integer on this host. VFP ~600 cycles/insn (V17 fenv calls; low priority).
CORE CHANGES (emu/n2a32_core.c, new emu/n2a32_fast.h; include/n2a32.h unchanged): per-thread decode cache re-validated against the fetched word on every hit (no invalidation needed, SMC-safe); ~70 predecoded T16/T32 fast paths outside IT blocks; lean Thumb loop out of the sigsetjmp function; lock-free host-call lookup; hw-lead request: a failed nested n2a32_call in a shim now stops the outer run with the inner reason/address unless the shim set stop_request (V32 once keeps STOP_REQUEST); stop_request read atomically. Non-ABI switch n2a32_core_fastpath (tests).
OTHER FILES: emu/n2a32_t16.c 2 lines: BLX rm read LR after writing it (blx lr branched to its own return address; found by t_fast.c). emu/test_v02/t_core.c: routing test runs with fast paths off (it substitutes class functions) + new nested-UDF test (fails on the old core 414/417).
TESTS after: V02 868/868, V10 220589, V11 960, V12 200797, V14 449/453 (same 4 pre-existing failures as before), V15 1764, V16 3284977, V17 2264, V18 vendor PASS, V19 44435, V20 436882, T01 run_tests 5/5 and run_diff 19180/19180, R1 spot 308/308, V03 12971, V30 277633, V32 13149, V33 341, V34 2044, V40 1377, PERF (t_fast differential, 2.3 M single-step cases fast vs class) 2336354/2336354. make -C host ios: 33/33 arm64 objects. IV tsan build and V41 currently fail on ap/n2ap_venc.c edited by someone else at 17:01 (unused ven_sleep_ms; VENC_C1 refs) - not the core (V41 test does not run the interpreter).
NEW FILES: gpu/hwcodec/tests/perf/{bench.c,bench_kernels.c,run_bench.sh,n2perf_mix.c,mix_report.py,run_vmix.sh,t_fast.c,run_tests.sh,STATUS.md}. IP: please add _pthread_key_create/_pthread_setspecific (core) and _strnlen (V40) to daemon/sdk_symbols.txt.
